description: Authorship coverage scoreboard for a repo — the honest estimate of how much of the code's authorship is ON THE RECORD (known) vs undisclosed (unknown — origin unknown, NEVER guessed), the human/with_ai/ai mix OF THE KNOWN (never of the whole repo), the asserted-vs-verified trust split, and byAgent: the agents and model versions named in the AI commits, exactly as disclosed (a commit naming a tool and its model counts under both). Disclosure, not detection; the report is a labeled estimate (counts only — derive percents at the edge). Use it to show a maintainer their provenance picture and motivate requiring disclosure.

path.description: path to the repo (default: the server's working directory)

range.description: git commit range, e.g. origin/main..HEAD (default: recent history)

name: coverage
